early_visual.label: Early visual cortex (V1/V2)
early_visual.blurb: Edges, contrast and fine detail. Lights up for any rich visual scene.

motion.label: Visual motion (MT+/V5)
motion.blurb: Tracks moving things: optic flow, moving objects, camera pans.

faces.label: Face processing (fusiform / FFA)
faces.blurb: Recognising faces and expressions. Quiet when nobody is on screen.

places.label: Scenes and navigation (PPA / RSC)
places.blurb: Layouts, rooms, landmarks and knowing where you are.

objects.label: Object recognition (lateral occipital / IT)
objects.blurb: Shapes and objects as things, not just edges.

attention.label: Spatial attention (intraparietal / SPL)
attention.blurb: Where to look next, counting, tracking several things at once.

somatomotor.label: Sensorimotor cortex
somatomotor.blurb: Planning and feeling movement, hands and body.

frontal_control.label: Executive control (dorsolateral prefrontal)
frontal_control.blurb: Working memory, rules, holding a plan in mind.

language.label: Language network (IFG / STS)
language.blurb: Speech and meaning. In this build the text pathway is off, so treat as narration only.

default_mode.label: Default mode network
default_mode.blurb: Mind-wandering, self-reference, thinking about others. Tends to switch off when the world is loud.
